name: catalog-has-58-independent-tasks
description: The compiled catalog exposes exactly 58 runnable task directories.
given: A freshly compiled repository using the live upstream datasets and committed local packets
then: Exactly 58 unique tasks are found with one prompt and one normalized task file each

name: every-task-has-real-inputs
description: Every task resolves to substantive upstream or original source material.
given: The compiler has downloaded the selected benchmark materials
when: source_docs paths are resolved, including AA shared-pool symlinks
then: Every task has at least one readable non-empty source file, exact security snapshots may preserve empty upstream marker files, and every source file is represented in the SHA-256 manifest

name: coverage-spans-ten-benchmark-families
description: The suite combines four sourced knowledge-work benchmark families, retail diagnostics, Daytona Windows workflows, DataAgentBench, tax strategy execution, security source audits, and accounting-close work.
given: All selected upstream task IDs and local packets are compiled
then: The dataset counts are 4, 6, 6, 4, 3, 11, 7, 7, 5, and 5 for a total of 58 tasks

name: expected-deliverables-are-declared
description: Every prompt has one or more explicit output artifacts.
when: the deliverables field is checked against prompt.md
then: At least one non-empty expected filename is declared for every task

name: dataagentbench-live-source-rebuild
description: Seven DataAgentBench packets rebuild independently from the pinned GitHub revision and live Hugging Face data mirror.
given: An empty temporary task tree and network access to the real upstream services
when: compile_dataagentbench downloads metadata, graders, and query-specific databases
then: Seven complete task packets are produced and all mirrored files match the upstream size and SHA-256 manifest

name: dataagentbench-official-validators-accept-ground-truth
description: Every packaged DataAgentBench validator can score its corresponding answer contract.
when: the official validate function receives that task's ground_truth.csv content
then: All seven validators return a passing result

name: tax-strategy-packets-are-public-safe-and-deterministic
description: Seven 2026 tax strategy packets preserve the execution method without publishing the confidential manual or leaking answer keys to blind-run agents.
given: A clean temporary task tree built by scripts/build_tax_strategy_task_packets.py
when: the focused tax scenario validates metadata, sources, rubrics, and frozen calculations
then: All seven tasks have synthetic facts, official guidance, two declared deliverables, 100-point rubrics, hidden answer keys, and no PDF copy of the manual

name: augusta-rule-chicago-comparables-are-traceable
description: The Augusta Rule case uses real, dated Chicago asking-rate evidence without representing the listings as completed transactions.
given: Five normalized observations linked to public Peerspace and workin.space listing pages
when: the focused tax scenario sorts and evaluates calculation_inputs.csv
then: The rates are $288, $363, $385, $553, and $754, the median is $385, fourteen modeled days total $5,390, and every observation retains its retrieval date and source URL

name: crew-gantt-source-workbook-drives-three-scenarios
description: The screenshot-inspired crew Gantt task uses a real synthetic workbook with complete scenario-specific crew and hourly demand inputs.
when: the focused scenario imports the workbook and independently evaluates crews, overnight shifts, volume, staffing, and coverage
then: Base, Peak, and Lean reproduce their frozen KPI contracts, each has 168 demand observations and full-week staffing, and the private screenshot is absent

name: security-evals-are-pinned-blind-and-source-exact
description: Five security eval packets expose real vulnerable source without leaking the advisory or fix to the agent.
given: The pinned fixture manifest and five original source repositories are reachable
when: scripts/build_security_eval_packets.py materializes each bounded vulnerable snapshot and the focused security scenario compares metadata and bytes
then: All five source slices match their declared commits and licenses, agent-visible files omit target and fix data, hidden rubrics total 100 points, and each task requires security_findings.md

name: apex-accounting-packets-match-pinned-public-dev-set
description: Five accounting packets reproduce a balanced slice of the public APEX-Accounting development set without exposing grading data to the agent.
given: The pinned Mercor Hugging Face revision is reachable
when: scripts/build_apex_accounting_packets.py downloads the selected task records, licenses, and author-identified context files and the focused scenario compares them byte-for-byte
then: All five prompts, rubrics, gold answers, and source files match upstream, the four workflow categories are represented, answer.txt is required, and grader files remain hidden
